objective: Replace only the present-stream C2_B branch with a fixed CatBoost native-text expert; retain exact cached CatBoost missing-stream scores.

scope.fit_rows: All official Classification Train rows with 47 <= cycle_code <= cutoff, including rows whose signal_stream is missing or blank.

evaluation_rows.fit55: cycles 56-67 for H12_E, with cycles 56-59 reported as W1
evaluation_rows.fit67: cycles 68-79 for H12_L, with cycles 68-71 reported as W4

scope.routing: The original stream availability mask is computed before any text sentinel normalization. For validation rows, preserve the exact cached CB_MISSING probability on missing/blank streams and replace only present-stream C2_B probabilities with the candidate. The candidate's own probability is only requested for present validation rows.
scope.controls: Current champion is C2_B on present rows plus exact Round 1 CatBoost CB_MISSING cache on missing/blank rows. C4_HGB is not used.
scope.test_data: Do not read Test data or labels.

model.structured_features: Frozen expanded parser and native categorical design from the existing CatBoost missing expert; preprocessing fit on all fold-training rows.

dictionary.option_spelling_note: CatBoost 1.2.8 official Python Dictionary API spells this setting occurence_lower_bound.

blank_stream_handling.applies_to: Only missing/blank signal_stream cells passed to model fit/predict after the original availability mask is separately retained.
blank_stream_handling.fit_scope: Sentinel and vocabulary statistics are constructed only within each fold's official Train fit rows.

pilot_acceptance_gate.improvement: At least one of pooled W1+W4 primary Macro F1 or pooled H12 Macro F1 must exceed the current champion.
pilot_acceptance_gate.view_guardrail: No individual W1, W4, H12_E, or H12_L Macro F1 may be more than 0.01 below the current champion.
pilot_acceptance_gate.next_step: Report pilot to Main and stop. Do not begin cutoffs 59, 63, 71, or 75 without Main's explicit continuation decision.

reporting.no_tuning: No parameter sweep, threshold calibration, score calibration, blending, or Kaggle use.
